explication: Letta Code is a stateful agent harness accessed through a terminal, desktop, browser, or messaging channel. A typical interaction enters through the CLI or a channel, reaches a local or Letta Cloud backend, and produces an agent response; agents can also use tools and subagents. Agent memory, identity, prompts, and skills support long-term adaptation, with MemFS providing Git-tracked context. The README documents major capabilities and entry points; sampled source excerpts are partial, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
